name: @neetix/edge
description: On-device, offline face detection + passive liveness (+ match) in the browser. Rust→WebAssembly, models embedded in the wasm — your face never leaves the device.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check-wasm && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.check-wasm: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['wasm/neetix_edge.js','wasm/neetix_edge_bg.wasm']){if(!fs.existsSync(f)){console.error('MISSING '+f+' — run: npm run sync-wasm (see README). Publishing without the WASM binary ships a package that cannot load.');process.exit(1)}}const kb=fs.statSync('wasm/neetix_edge_bg.wasm').size/1024;if(kb<1024){console.error('wasm/neetix_edge_bg.wasm is only '+kb.toFixed(0)+'KB — that is the .d.ts placeholder, not the binary');process.exit(1)}console.log('wasm ok ('+(kb/1024).toFixed(1)+'MB)')"

author: Neetix (https://neetix.in)
